records.part: Procurement and delivery of the ATEC Water Filtration System (wellhead treatment) for future installation at Pump Station 347
records.reason: ATEC Water Systems, LLC. (ATEC) is the sole supplier of the ATEC Water Filtration System, the City's preferred product in this region

records.part: 8-36" Dia Vessels with 4" Header Piping, 42" Pyrolox Media, Controller, Valves, Underdrains, and Victaulic Connections to Owner's piping
records.reason: ATEC is the sole source of the ATEC Water Filtration System.

records.part: Estimated Shipping to Fresno for Tanks and Media
records.reason: ATEC is the sole source of the ATEC Water Filtration System.

records.part: Main operating valve on each filter tank, industrial automatic multi-port diaphragm type
records.reason: Main operating valves shall be Bermad IR-4x4-350-P. Substitutions will not be allowed.

records.part: Factory-mounted and wired cycle controller for automatic backwash
records.reason: The controller to be used is an Alex-Tronic F-24, or similar, which requires a 120 VAC connection which provides a local panel indication of backwash status and alarm.

records.part: Fusion bonded epoxy coating for filter vessel immersion service surfaces and manifold immersion surfaces
records.reason: All filter vessel immersion service surfaces and manifold immersion surfaces shall be coated with 3M Corporation ScotchKote 134, a fusion bonded epoxy coating, certified to ANSI/NSF Standard 61 for contact with potable water

records.part: Filter media, NSF/ANSI Standard 61 listed manganese dioxide media, 0.42mm to 0.85mm
records.reason: The media shall be Pyrolox Advantage.

records.part: Tubing between the main operating valves and the pilot control valves, ¼" OD rated 300 psi
records.reason: Tubing between the main operating valves and the pilot control valves shall be ¼" OD and rated for 300 psi as manufactured by Parker or approved equal.

records.part: 3-Way Solenoid Valves used to control water or air that actuates the 3-Way Backwash Control Valves
records.reason: Peter-Paul Model 73 3-Way Solenoid Valves are used to control the water or air that actuates the 3-Way Backwash Control Valves.
